text.p: British biotechnology company Xenova Group Plc said on Tuesday it had created a new subsidiary called Xenova Discovery Ltd.
The company said in a statement that the current people, business and assets of Xenova's existing discovery division has been transferred to the new subsidiary.
The new unit will take over responsibility for discovery-related management of Xenova's existing collaborative agreements.

Louis Nisbet, chief executive of Xenova Group said, "This represents a significant step forward in the strategic development of Xenova, establishing a clear division of roles and responsibilities between the Discovery business, the existing Therapeutics division and MetaXen, our US subsidiary.
"We will be seeking to make Discovery a cash generative business in its own right."
The company has appointed David Oxlade as chief executive of the new subsidiary. He was previously president of the Syva division of Behring Diagnostics Inc.
